description: This file defines the interface and class implementations for a version 2 reporter in the Playwright testing framework, including methods for handling test events, reporting, and output streaming.

classes.name: ReporterV2Wrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that adapts a Reporter to the ReporterV2 interface, handling deferred output and method forwarding.

methods.name: wrapReporterAsV2
methods.description: Wraps a Reporter or ReporterV2 instance as a ReporterV2, returning the original if already version 2.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the string 'v2', indicating the reporter version.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the reporter.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test suite, forwards to the underlying reporter and processes deferred outputs.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Called when a test begins, forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output chunks, deferring if necessary.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error chunks, deferring if necessary.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Called when a test ends, forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of all tests, forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Handles process exit, forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Called at the beginning of a test step, forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of a test step, forwards to the underlying reporter.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates if the reporter prints to stdio, defaults to true if not specified.
